about: Every known engine-vs-translator fact disagreement (tests/tools/fact_crosscheck.py, #4273): id -> cause. A cause names the side that is wrong (engine / translator / definitional) and its issue. A two-way ratchet: CI fails on a new disagreement AND on one listed here that no longer reproduces, so a PR that fixes a disagreement must lower this ledger (`fact_crosscheck.py update`) in the same PR. Triage new ones with `assign`.

cvda-dfhvalue.summary: MOVE DFHVALUE(x) TO y: the engine records the operand as written (DFHVALUE), the translator its CVDA number (det/cvda.py). Same move.

engine-drops-self-transfer.summary: A GO TO back to its own paragraph (a read loop): the engine drops a unit's transfer to itself like recursion (#3362 contract, ground-truth ledger 'deliberate'); the translator and the key keep it.

engine-main-line-no-extent.summary: The main line (statements before the first paragraph) has no extent in the engine (a synthetic calls-only unit, ground-truth ledger engine_main_line_in_no_unit); the translator's (MAIN) and the key have it.

numeric-value-spelling.summary: A numeric VALUE as written (0225, 00: the engine and the key) vs as a number (225, 0: the translator parses it).

pointer-width.summary: POINTER is 4 bytes on z/OS (the engine, the keys) and 8 in the translator's storage, GnuCOBOL on x86-64 (oracle_assumptions.md C9): every field after one moves by 4. Both right for their platform.

translator-copy-program-member.summary: COPY SHPRATE / COPY ORDPRICE: by design no copy library of the estate holds the member, only a program source of that name (estate-crucible horror H-0053; its key: 'no compiler finds it'). The engine records the gap and the translator refuses the program by name (CopyUnresolved, #4468; before #4468 det.source spliced the program in, #4460). A correct refusal on both sides.

translator-refuses-idms.summary: Refused by name since #4462 (source.unmodelled, 'IDMS DML not supported'): an IDMS-DC program (IDMS-CONTROL / SCHEMA SECTION; estate-crucible LOAN LNIDMS01). Its DML (BIND RUN-UNIT, READY, OBTAIN CALC, FINISH, DC RETURN) and subschema records are not modelled; IDMS support is #4532.

translator-refuses-national-text.summary: Refused by name since #4462 (source.unmodelled), never laid out wrong: national / DBCS text (Kanji names and literals, PIC G, ideographic spaces: estate-crucible KYUY, decoded in its declared cp930 / shift_jis or UTF-8; the translator lays records out one byte a character; #4272), and a single-byte national letter in a data name (DEUT ZINSBER's GEBÜHR / BETRÄGE in cp273: the grammar reads ASCII words only; #4664). ZINSBER's DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA is modelled since #4462 (test_det_programs DPCOMMA).

translator-refuses-source-defect.summary: Refused by name since #4462 (layout._missing_period): a data entry with no period before the next level number (GenApp polloo2.cpy's 03 CA-CUSPOL-REQUEST). The source is defective; the engine reads past it, the translator never lays out a guess at it. Since #4735 also by name (source.cut_literal): program text past column 72 of a fixed-form line (a host variable cut short, a comma lost: NexusBank NEND-DAY), and a file that is a saved ISPF editor screen, not COBOL (source.NotCobol). Nothing to fix on either side.

translator-refuses-vendor-copybook.summary: Refused: an IBM MQ (CMQ*) or LE (CEEIGZCT) copybook the estate does not ship; the engine records the COPY unresolved. Nothing is wrong on either side.

value-all-literal.summary: VALUE ALL '#': the engine and the key record ALL, the translator ALL '#' (its value is the repeated literal).
